title: Graph Document — Employees and Departments
description: Schema for the graph-document.json example (§8.12). Demonstrates horizontal relationships expressed via { "$ref-id": "..." } within a single graph document: Employee.department (has-one → Department) and Employee.manager (optional has-one → Employee, self-referential).

Department.title: Department
Department.description: An organizational department. Exists independently — multiple Employees can reference the same Department.

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: An employee belonging to a Department. HAS-ONE HORIZONTAL → Department via $ref-id (the Department object is stored separately in 'objects' and shared across Employees). Optional HAS-ONE HORIZONTAL → Employee (self-referential manager link).

department.description: HAS-ONE HORIZONTAL: in a graph document this is expressed as { "$ref-id": "<dept-$id>" } rather than a bare ID string or an embedded object.

manager.description: Optional HAS-ONE HORIZONTAL (self-referential): the employee's direct manager, also expressed as a $ref-id reference.
